summary: A 236-unit affordable apartment complex (up to 60% AMI) at 420 Berry Street in Mission Bay North, next to Mission Creek Park, developed by Related Companies and Chinatown Community Development Center and designed by David Baker & Associates to follow the curve of the adjacent Caltrain tracks. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8703, lot 006) records the building's construction year as 2007.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200505112108 filed to erect a 4-story, 236-dwelling-unit residential building at 420 Berry St
Building completed, per DataSF Assessor tax roll

costs.what: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200505112108's revised construction-cost valuation for the 4-story, 236-unit affordable building at 420 Berry St (the permit's initial filed estimate was $5,000,000)
